name: Colin Morris
text:
Eventually settled on Garuda Linux. I did have some free partition space available for some other reasons and so Monday morning I took the leap with little precaution. Though I did have the sense to back some stuff up before proceeding.

Welcome to the Garuda Club! I chose Garuda on the advise of some friends who daily-drivered Linux and also liked gaming. I'd just got a new PC and did not want to get Windows all over it, which is a good time to move. It's been over 15 months now, and no regrets. Some things I've found so far

  • I can't play any of the non-Java Minecrafts because they just refuse to run in wine. Fine.
  • Moving saves over was fairly easy. Steam had most of my stuff in the cloud, and others I had a spare portable hard drive I copied my user directory over to so I could replace where neccessary.
  • Dragonized... yeah, super gaudy. I've got a very simple style now.
  • My printers get... interesting every now and then. My old Canon is fine now, tho, printing in duplex and multi-cartridge etc. But the Fuji printer keeps getting forgotten or misdrivered so it just prints code. Bleh.
  • Using Podman makes my multiple development environments breezy to use.
  • I was using Macs for a while, and iTunes has no Linux equivalent. Even running it in Wine is a giant pain. Oh well.

Still, welcome, hope it all goes truly great for you.
